title: Preserve GNSS versus gpsd provenance at stratum 4
description: Correctness/spec-compliance review finding. Stratum.GNSS_GPSD in python/src/lichen/timing/time_sync.py:91-109 is normatively GNSS or Local-client, but STRATUM_SOURCE_CLASS maps it unconditionally to SourceClass.GNSS. python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:96-103 asserts the collapsed mapping. spec/09-packets-timing.md:176-209 classifies gpsd as Local-client and makes that class policy-gated, while direct GNSS is a distinct default-trusted class. Treating gpsd as GNSS bypasses provenance and policy distinctions and can grant local-client data unintended authority.
acceptance_criteria: Replace the one-to-one stratum mapping with a representation that preserves the actual source class and source name/provenance, or explicitly represents every allowed class for a stratum without inferring which supplied a sample. A gpsd/local-client stratum-4 sample MUST remain Local-client and require its policy; on-device GNSS MUST remain GNSS and require GNSS time validity. Tests must cover both sources at stratum 4, distinct default policy outcomes, serialization/adoption without provenance loss, and status/diagnostic exposure. Align spec/vector wording if needed and run focused tests plus three code-review passes per modified source module.
